subject: Finera MAP: POC milestone checkpoint & acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Murray <alex.murray@finera.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Subject: Finera MAP: POC milestone checkpoint & acceptance criteria

Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, I wanted to capture the current MAP checkpoint for the 2-week POC so we have aligned milestones, acceptance criteria, and owners going into the trial. Attaching the updated MAP workbook (finera_map_v2.xlsx).

Quick summary (current plan):
- POC window: Feb 17 — Mar 4
- Primary objective: Validate Redwood inference latency under Finera throughput (8k tokens/session average, 250 concurrent sessions) and confirm end-to-end integration with your enrichment pipeline.

Milestones & acceptance criteria (condensed):
1) Environment & onboarding — owner: Rishi (target: Feb 19)
   - Acceptance: Secure connectivity established (VPC peering + test credentials), baseline inference calls succeed against sample dataset.
2) Performance validation — owner: Rishi (target: Feb 24)
   - Acceptance: 95th percentile token latency <= 180ms at target throughput; sustained QPS within 10% of expected.
3) Functional alignment & accuracy checks — owner: Hannah (target: Feb 25)
   - Acceptance: Top-1 intent match >= 92% on mapped test set; no critical regressions vs. Finera baseline.
4) Trial sign-off & rollout plan — owner: Soojin (target: Mar 4)
   - Acceptance: Exec confirmation to proceed; commercial terms agreed or next-step mutual action items captured.

Current blockers flagged:
- A: Test harness configuration (timeout and batching) — Rishi needs elevated access to the staging queue.
- B: Data sample refresh — Finera to provide updated dataset with redactions by Feb 19.

Action items (owners):
- Rishi: Finish VPC configuration and smoke tests by Feb 19. (Rishi)
- Hannah: Prepare accuracy eval harness and share initial metrics by Feb 25. (Hannah)
- Alex: Provide redacted dataset link and point-of-contact for procurement (Alex)
- Soojin: Send weekly checkpoint notes and update MAP workbook after each sync (Soojin)

Meeting cadence: Weekly checkpoints Tuesdays 2:00pm PT (next one: Feb 24). If anything slips, call it out in the workspace and we’ll triage.

References: MAP workbook attached; HubSpot deal FIN-2026-042 linked.

Thanks — looking forward to progress.

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Soojin —

Appreciate the clear breakdown. Quick clarifications from our side after reviewing the MAP workbook: 
- We can provide a redacted dataset by EOD Feb 19; I’ll drop the S3 link to the shared drive and add our procurement contact (Marina).

I’m available for the 2/24 checkpoint; please send calendar invite.

Morning all —

Status update on the onboarding and perf validation items: 
- VPC peering completed (staging). I’ve pushed test credentials to the secure folder and left notes on access.
- Ran baseline throughput/latency tests against the Finera sample: preliminary logs attached (poe_test_logs.zip). Results: at 250 concurrent sessions with our current batching policy, P95 token latency is 190–210ms. At more aggressive batching the P95 moves closer to 165–175ms but tail variance increases under burst.

Immediate blockers and mitigations:
1) Timeout and batching knobs need tuning in your staging traffic pattern — I need the exact client-side timeout and concurrency pattern to mirror. (Blocker — action: Alex to share sample traffic profile)
2) Security attestation: I added the key access table to the onboarding checklist; need confirmation of rotation cadence from Finera security. (Blocker — action: Alex/Marina)

Proposed short-term mitigations we can apply this week:
- Apply adaptive batching policy for the POC (low-risk change) to reduce average token latency without impacting throughput. (Owner: Rishi)
- Add a small inference cache for repeated prefixes to stabilize tail latency for identical session starts. (Owner: Rishi + Dev Team)

Next steps for our Feb 24 checkpoint: I’ll re-run the perf test with adaptive batching once I have the traffic pattern and post updated logs.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Alex / team —

Thanks for the updates and Rishi for the logs. Recap from today’s checkpoint and agreed adjustments: 
- We’ll keep the POC window open through Mar 4 but move the internal performance milestone target: demonstration of P95 <= 180ms by Feb 27 with a documented plan to reach 160ms by Mar 4 (owner: Rishi).
- Alex to share the redacted dataset link and the traffic profile by EOD Feb 24. If we don’t receive it, Rishi will run with a synthetic profile that approximates your described pattern.
- Security attestation: Marina to confirm key rotation cadence and provide access confirmation; we’ll hold any environment changes until we get that note.
- Hannah will push the first accuracy run by Feb 25; we'll surface any functional regressions in the MAP workbook.

Action item summary (updated owners & due dates):
- Rishi: Adaptive batching + re-run perf tests (target: Feb 27) — attachment: poe_test_logs.zip included.
- Hannah: Accuracy eval run (target: Feb 25).
- Alex / Marina: Redacted dataset link + traffic profile + key rotation cadence (target: Feb 24).
- Soojin: Update MAP workbook and schedule final sign-off review (target: Mar 3).

Next checkpoint: Tues Mar 3, 2:00pm PT — final POC acceptance review. I’ll share a short agenda and dial-in in the invite.

If anything changes before then, flag it in the thread. Appreciate everyone’s swift responses — great progress.
